verdict.rationale: Typesense has no named sandbox or test-mode feature. You can still test in isolation: the open-source server runs locally or on any server via Docker and other installers, the production guide covers running tests with Testcontainers and in GitHub Actions, and the Cloud MCP server lets an agent create separate clusters. Isolation therefore comes from spinning up your own throwaway instance rather than from a managed sandbox. missing for 10: a dedicated first-party sandbox or test environment (e.g. Cloud dev/test clusters or a seeded sample dataset), docs explicitly on isolating agent testing from production data, independent or hands-on corroboration.
